title: ADR with wrong authorityLevel value
context: An ADR whose authorityLevel is not the const value adr.
decision: Test that a non-adr authorityLevel is rejected.
consequences: The artefact would claim the wrong authority rank.
forbiddenDrift: Do not set authorityLevel to any value other than adr.
aiAlignmentRules: Stop if authorityLevel disagrees with the schema const.
permittedChanges: The authorityLevel value may be corrected by a recorded decision.
description: Defect: authorityLevel is 'semantic-definition', not the const 'adr'.
aiGuidance: This instance must be rejected because authorityLevel is not adr.
